internal_precedent.relevant_detail: Practical standardized field-validation starting protocol: 100 m search radius and 30 minutes active searching per site; actual effort recorded.
Existing broad vascular-plant reconnaissance default: 90 search minutes per candidate cell and one minimum repeat visit; explicitly not species-specific.

external_method_context.citation: MacKenzie & Royle 2005, Journal of Applied Ecology, DOI 10.1111/j.1365-2664.2005.01098.x
external_method_context.relevant_detail: General occupancy-design guidance recommends at least three repeat surveys when per-survey detection is high; this is not a Cirsium-specific validation.

external_method_context.citation: Zhang et al. 2014, PLOS ONE, DOI 10.1371/journal.pone.0095334
external_method_context.relevant_detail: Vascular-plant surveys showed substantial missed richness at 20 minutes and continued rare-plant detections after 20 minutes; this is not a focal-Cirsium protocol calibration.

external_method_context.citation: Rimgailė-Voicik & Naujalis 2022, Applications in Plant Sciences, DOI 10.1002/aps3.11458
external_method_context.relevant_detail: Timed-meander focal-plant searches may use 30-60 minute search durations depending on area; about 30 minutes was given as a general estimate for a 0.5-ha club-moss site.

synthesis: Use three equal 30-minute one-observer searches. This preserves the existing ACSP 30-minute timed-search precedent while retaining 90 total person-minutes per candidate, equal to the repository's broad vascular-plant reconnaissance time budget, and adds repeat visits without introducing arm-, candidate-, movement-, outcome-, day-, or monetary-budget tuning.
claim_boundary: This is a preregistered common comparison protocol, not an empirically optimal Cirsium search duration.
It does not estimate occupancy or detection probability.
It does not imply that a completed non-detection is biological absence.
The same effort values apply to all four taxa and all three frozen method arms.
Prospective outcomes cannot be used to change these values.
